* fix: CORS x-access-token allowlist + network-error normalization (live QA)

Found by actually running the app: the demo CORS middleware never allowlisted
x-access-token (only the old X-User-* headers), so every real browser request
preflight-failed. Separately, EstimatorApiService's error handling used ??,
which doesn't catch a CORS-blocked request's err.error (a ProgressEvent, not
null) -- it leaked through as if it were a valid EstimateResponse, crashing
the template on undefined.toLocaleString(). Also: dev-local.sh/angular.json
fixes for the Angular port (port 4200 not Vite's 5173, analytics prompt).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(dev-local): stop forcing AI_DEV_AUTH=true, it silently overrides .env

Shell env vars win over server.ts's dotenv-style loadEnv() (which only sets a
key if unset), so hardcoding AI_DEV_AUTH=true here made ai-estimator/.env's
AI_DEV_AUTH=false meaningless -- the backend kept trusting spoofable X-User-*
headers the Angular app never sends, 403ing every real request regardless of
a valid platform token. Let .env's own value take effect.

- tests/helpers/auth.ts: no more login UI to click through. Signs a real JWT

  own claim shape, injects it into localStorage["user"] via addInitScript

- estimate-card/spec-card specs updated for the new placeholder/button text

- New access-denied.spec.ts: no session, and the unmapped CONSULTANTS role

  super_admin same-project-set gap as a known behavior (not silently assumed).

  found via manual QA: EstimatorApiService's `?? fallback` didn't catch a

* fix(estimator): key intake_forms cache, dedupe concurrent fetches, evict stale summary entries

- getCachedIntakeForms now keys its cache Map by an explicit cache key
  instead of one bare slot, so a fetch for a different endpoint can never
  silently return another endpoint's cached dataset. All 4 callers
  (estimate/spec via filter.ts's defaultDeps, summary.ts's
  fetchAllIntakeForms, and projectSelector.ts via that same function) now
  pass the shared INTAKE_FORMS_CACHE_KEY explicitly.
- The cache slot stores the fetch promise itself, not just the resolved
  value, so concurrent requests on a cold/expired cache await one shared
  fetch instead of each firing their own (thundering-herd guard). A
  rejected fetch clears its slot so the next call retries.
- summary.ts's runSummary now deletes an expired _summaryCache entry on
  read instead of just falling through, so the Map doesn't grow forever.
- projectSelector.ts's buildProjectLabel falls back to bare city when
  state is missing, instead of dropping location entirely.

* fix(estimator): close 5 backend security audit findings

- sessionStore: periodic TTL sweep (setInterval, unref'd) closes unbounded
  Map growth from client-supplied sessionIds; sessionId length now capped
  in estimate/spec routes the same way query length already was.
- routes: add express-rate-limit (20 req/min/user, IP fallback) ahead of
  all four /api/ai/* routers to cap Anthropic/Data Graph spend from a
  looping caller.
- intentParser: allowlist city's charset/length in the LLM extraction
  path (toIntentResult) so it can't carry arbitrary/injection-shaped text
  into the Claude prompt context — invalid values drop to null like the
  other closed-enum fields already do.
- platformAuth: drop the query-string token branch (JWTs in URLs leak via
  proxy logs and Referer); header/body only, matching the documented
  contract.
- platformAuth + tokenGenerator: pin jwt.verify/jwt.sign to HS256 for
  defense-in-depth against algorithm-confusion attacks.

224 existing + 10 new tests, all green; tsc --noEmit clean.

- Add aria-live/aria-busy to the async result regions in estimate-card, spec-card,
  and project-selector.
- Add aria-label to the query input (query-form).
- Promote card headings from h3 to h2 to fix the h1->h3 hierarchy skip (no CSS was
  keyed on the h3 tag).
- Add data-testid attributes to the elements the e2e suite locates by role/text,

* feat(estimator): add npm run token for manual browser testing

No script existed to generate a real platform JWT for pasting into a
browser console -- only e2e/tests/helpers/auth.ts's loginAs(), which
is Playwright-only and never prints the token. Surfaced when the user
